benchmarks.definition: Break-even game payoff; primary Sharpe-like benchmark.
benchmarks.label: Zero payoff

benchmarks.definition: Village roles use villager_random_vote; werewolves use wolf_random_kill when available.
benchmarks.label: Role-specific random strategy mean

benchmarks.definition: R4 reference_strategy_mix condition mean by role.
benchmarks.label: Existing default strategy mix

financial_analogy_boundary: Metrics are empirical game-payoff analogues, not literal market returns, investment performance, regulatory VaR, or portfolio Sharpe ratios.

metric_definitions.formula: sample standard deviation of player-game payoff
metric_definitions.label: Payoff volatility

metric_definitions.formula: empirical lower-tail payoff quantile at 1 - confidence
metric_definitions.label: VaR-like payoff threshold

metric_definitions.formula: mean(-payoff for payoff at or below VaR-like threshold)
metric_definitions.label: CVaR-like downside loss

metric_definitions.formula: (mean payoff - benchmark payoff) / payoff standard deviation
metric_definitions.label: Sharpe-like payoff ratio

metric_definitions.formula: payoff excluding opportunity cost plus opportunity cost
metric_definitions.label: Opportunity-cost-adjusted payoff

metric_definitions.formula: mean payoff with useful information event minus without
metric_definitions.label: Information premium

metric_definitions.formula: mean wolf payoff with manipulation event minus without
metric_definitions.label: Manipulation premium

primary_analysis_unit: player-game for role payoff; game for game outcomes
